feedback: Pre-race review of the iteration 3 candidate. It reverts the sensor array to the iteration 1 narrow layout (x = ±0.03, ±0.015, 0, 15 mm spacing, 12 mm footprints). Iteration 1 was the best raced design at 178.2, and iteration 2 showed that widening to 22.5 mm spacing cut the score to 81.1 with no gain in line retention (line_loss_events stayed at 1.0, max_error near 0.062). Reverting geometry is therefore well supported. The controller moves are small: kd 0.3 to 0.25 and kp 2.5 to 2.2, with base_speed 1.3, ki 0 and last_direction unchanged. The rationale says kp is held at 2.5 in one place and lowered to 2.2 in another. The candidate's values are what I am approving, so the Optimizer should confirm the intended kp when revising. Iteration 1 oscillation was 0.34 on the oval and 0.24 on the s-bend, so lower kd is a reasonable test. The oscillation link to kd is confounded with the geometry change in iteration 2, so it is not proven. Sensor_weights and signal sign convention are valid, and every field is within its contract limits. The candidate is not clearly better than iteration 1, but it is a sound, small step from the best design and the race will give useful telemetry. Next race: if line_loss_events remain at 1 or more and max_error stays near 0.06, lower base_speed to about 1.1 while holding the geometry. If the runs finish but completion_time is above 3.0 s, raise base_speed toward 1.6. If oscillation stays above about 0.25 on the oval and s-bend, lower kd further or kp toward 2.0.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events stay at 1 or more and max_error stays near 0.06 with the narrow array, lower base_speed to about 1.1 and hold the geometry and gains, since iteration 1 at speed 1.3 with the narrow array was the best raced result but still left the line.

If runs finish but completion_time is above 3.0 s, raise base_speed toward 1.6 and hold kp and kd, since iteration 1 finished the oval in about 1.97 s at 1.3 and the 3 s limit needs about 1.5 m/s average.
If steering_oscillation stays above about 0.25 on the oval or s-bend, lower kd toward 0.2 or kp toward 2.0, since iteration 1 (kd 0.3) gave oscillation of 0.34 on the oval and 0.24 on the s-bend.
